assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service description is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The denial was issued because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for continuous rhythm assessment to accurately correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management.
